# Temporal Precision

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:TemporalPrecision`](gmeow-TemporalPrecision.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TemporalPrecision>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The granularity to which an event's time is known — day, month, year, decade, or circa. A value carried by [`gmeow:temporalPrecision`](../properties/gmeow-temporalPrecision.md); pairs with [`gmeow:earliestStart`](../properties/gmeow-earliestStart.md) / [`gmeow:latestEnd`](../properties/gmeow-latestEnd.md) to express a fuzzy date without abandoning DL-clean [xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) base triples.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:TemporalPrecision`](gmeow-TemporalPrecision.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the dating-granularity axis — the levels (day / month / year / decade / circa) that [`gmeow:temporalPrecision`](../properties/gmeow-temporalPrecision.md) draws from to say how precisely an event's time is known.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it as the date itself (the bounds are [`gmeow:earliestStart`](../properties/gmeow-earliestStart.md) / [`gmeow:latestEnd`](../properties/gmeow-latestEnd.md)) and avoid the former free-text gmeow:eventDate string; precision is an explicit value, not prose, and is distinct from epistemic [`gmeow:confidence`](../properties/gmeow-confidence.md).

### How to use

- Reference one [`gmeow:TemporalPrecision`](gmeow-TemporalPrecision.md) individual via [`gmeow:temporalPrecision`](../properties/gmeow-temporalPrecision.md) alongside the [`gmeow:earliestStart`](../properties/gmeow-earliestStart.md) + [`gmeow:latestEnd`](../properties/gmeow-latestEnd.md) bounds that bracket the fuzzy date, keeping the base triples DL-clean [xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)

### Examples

- ex:battle [`gmeow:temporalPrecision`](../properties/gmeow-temporalPrecision.md) [`gmeow:precisionDecade`](../individuals/gmeow-precisionDecade.md).
